title: Unit Event — Whip Yourself into Shape!

meta.Outline: An psyches herself up to work on the task she's been given, but there's hesitation in her singing. When she realizes that her unease over Kohane is causing the problem, An calls her out to Vivid Street to settle things once and for all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... I think I'm supposed to take a left up here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(There's nobody else around.
I guess I am here earlier than usual.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Still, why did she ask to meet me here today...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry for asking you to meet me on such short notice when we're not supposed to have practice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I've actually been waking up early to practice projecting my voice on our days off.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? You really do have an amazing work ethic. Even on days off, you're raring to sing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Anyway, An, why did you want to meet with me today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You said it was something important...
Shouldn't we talk at the cafe instead of on the street...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, we have to talk here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I actually need to ask you for a favor.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it has to do with my task.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh...
The one your dad gave you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: After giving it a lot of thought, I finally realized what I needed to do in order to accomplish it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... I don't think I can do it on my own.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why I need your help, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If that's the case, I'll be more than happy to help!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, what do you need me to do?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I need you to battle against me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Lay it on me.
I'll do whatever is it that I need to do.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Good, that's what I like to hear.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Get all the locals behind you.
Everyone who watched you grow up.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I've mentioned this a few times before, but RAD WEEKEND attained its legendary status because of the emotion that went into it. Very strong emotion.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
And that emotion...
It developed over a long period of time here on Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: This place where true music lovers gather.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: If you're serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND, then you'll need to get everyone around here involved.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Because their feelings are just that powerful.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: If they hadn't wholeheartedly wanted to respect Nagi's last wishes and give her the send-off she wanted, then I doubt RAD WEEKEND would've become what it did.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, you'll need to find a way to get them on their feet. However...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: They're not paying attention to what you're doing right now. Or rather, there's no way for them to at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Nagi's wish was for the next generation to carry on her dream. So, they do want you to go beyond her dream.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But they're also still holding on to the memory of her, even without realizing it... I mean, they can't really help it since her shadow looms so large over this place...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Also, their guilt toward you may be keeping them from looking you in the eye.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Not the desire to honor Nagi's wishes.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You need to get them to truly want to see the moment you achieve your goal.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Get them to truly want that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...
I get what you're saying, Ken, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why was I the only one who didn't know something this important?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
None of this makes any sense!
I thought everybody was on my side! We were all like family!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Seriously, why?! I don't get it! Why only me...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An's the one who has to do this, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Only An can do this.
Like Nagi, she grew up here, and the locals have always treated her like she was family.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Everyone around here has watched An grow up and chase after Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And they're acutely aware of how she wanted An to carry on her dream.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which is why she's the only one who can do this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for showing so much concern for me, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But I should be fine.
I'll find a way to succeed.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still can't forgive them for not telling me about Aunt Nagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But... I also get why they did that.
They were just respecting her final wishes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I actually had a chance to talk to them a little while back. A few of them came to me, including the owner of Crawl Green.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
...
We're sorry for staying quiet about her.

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
...
We're sorry, An! We kept something this important from you this whole time!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
We don't expect you to forgive us.
We don't deserve that. Not one of us.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: But, yes... We really are sorry.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I'm not...sure what to say right now...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Right. We're sorry for ambushing you like this.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Thank you for letting us talk to you, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wasn't able to say anything to them that time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I feel a lot better now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know they cared about Aunt Nagi, just like I did.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Then, the rest is up to you.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Go show them that you're just as passionate about what you're doing as we were.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Phew...
We discussed a lot of stuff today. I'm exhausted.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But I don't have time to relax right now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I have to do this. Starting tonight.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I have to get them to believe in us.
I have to do everything I can to make that happen...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (All that's left is to figure out how...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
(I need them to hear that I'm committed to this goal.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (By putting on the best performance I can for them.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And I'm gonna make a declaration to them the same way Aunt Nagi did.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm gonna tell them that we're going to go beyond her dream...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (My mind's made up, so I've gotta find a way to get better. I'll start by practicing more on my own and...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wonder if Dad's still at the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Okay. Then, I'll leave the rest to you.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Phew...
Now that I managed to get ahold of Granny, I should probably get ready to head out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Aha!
Thank goodness you're still here.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Hm? What are you doing here so late? Don't forget that we have practice tomorrow morning.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...
But I'm not really in the mood for sleep right now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So, can you watch me practice for a bit?
I didn't get to sing much today, so just thirty minutes!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Then, sit back and listen!
Comment when you feel the need!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, where's the mic...? Actually, it's pretty late, so I probably shouldn't use it. Anyway, I'll sing...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (Looks like she's on the right path...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (I honestly wasn't sure how An would take the task I gave her.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (Especially considering how hard it's been for the locals to talk to her...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (I was fairly certain that she'd have trouble seeing them in the same light she used to...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (But I may've been wrong about that...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, I'm all set!
You ready?!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (I'm not hearing any of the hesitation I did before. She's throwing everything she has into her singing.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Yeah, I'm projecting my voice well.
But...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'll need to do more than just that.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I need to learn how to have as much energy as Aunt Nagi did that night.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (No, more than that. More than anyone else!)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Sorry, An.
Stop for a second.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Why'd you want me to stop, Dad?
Was I off-key?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
No, you sounded great. Pitch perfect and flawless rhythm.
It's just...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Is there something on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Is there something on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You hesitated just now while you were singing.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: At first, I thought you were thinking about everyone in town, but... I'm not so sure now.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
What's got you so hung up?
There's definitely something lingering in your mind.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's got me so hung up...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Looks like you know the answer.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's something I've...probably been thinking about for a really long time now.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
A really long time...?
What do you—

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I never would've thought that it'd affect my singing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've been hung up about Kohane for the longest time.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I thought I'd gotten over all that after talking to Akito and Miku.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I decided to keep singing with my partner and stay by her side.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I made the commitment to set aside my uncertainties and move forward.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (My stomach sinks every time I see Kohane reach new heights.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That's what's motivated me to keep working hard...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But as long as this feeling lingers...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: If you hesitate at all while you sing, your audience will notice.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That doubt might handicap you significantly...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't go on like this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, if you don't do something, you don't think you can accomplish the task Ken gave you...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: As long as I keep feeling this way about Kohane, I'm never going to be able to get the locals to believe that we're going to go beyond Aunt Nagi's dream.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND happened because she was able to get them to believe in what she was doing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... Here I am feeling so unsure.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know I have to do this, but Kohane sings so well that it keeps reminding me of Aunt Nagi... And all that doubt wells up inside of me again...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If I don't do something about this, then I'm probably never going to be able to get everyone behind what we're doing the way Aunt Nagi did.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I want to find a way to get rid of this doubt.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I haven't been able to come up with a solution on my own...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What you're talking about has nothing to do with what Kohane's done. It's a matter of how you feel.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane said that she isn't going anywhere, and I know I just need to keep doing my best...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I keep thinking about how...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Argh!
I hate being indecisive like this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I...probably sound really lame right now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're not lame at all, An!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm not entirely sure what's going on, but you're nervous that Kohane's sort of jumped ahead of you, right?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Isn't that just another way of saying she means that much to you?! Lame isn't the word I'd use here!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh no! Wh-What have I done...?!
Sorry, everyone! I was just trying to...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sorry, Shiraishi.
We just happened to overhear your conversation. I was actually just asking Luka for her opinion regarding my song...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Y-You shouldn't be the one apologizing, Toya! It's my fault for suggesting that we listen to what was going on for a little bit! I'm really sorry!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But... I meant every word of what I just said! I don't think you're lame at all, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But there's no need for you to apologize so much. There's no use crying over spilt milk.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If anything, can I ask you guys for some advice regarding this?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anything you can tell me will be really appreciated! The more the better!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
I didn't realize you felt that way about Azusawa, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Sorry for not saying anything sooner. I wasn't sure if I should since it's to do with my own feelings.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's not a problem.
Everyone has things that they don't wish to talk about.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still... Shiraishi, it's strange to see you filled with so much doubt.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, Azusawa is an incredible singer.
And she's been growing at a phenomenal rate.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But the same is true of you, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The way you sang when we battled against Taiga was remarkable. I don't see much of a gap between you and Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree.
You two make for a pair of good rivals.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But... Me just saying that probably isn't going to make you feel all that much better. It's easy to start asking yourself, “What if someday...?”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: By the way, what have you two been feeling as you watched Kohane grow?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes.
The key to helping An may lie in any differences between the way you've been feeling compared to her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've...been viewing her as a reliable teammate.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The way her singing evolves with each passing day has allowed us to reach new heights.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In that sense, I also think she's been our fuel.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Every time she finds a new gear, it drives us to keep up with her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, I see!
I like your answer, Akito!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay...
It's good to hear you guys' opinions.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I really get what you two were saying...
Every time I hear Kohane sing, I'm glad that she's on our team. I also think she's reliable, and that she motivates me to become better.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So much doubt has been welling up inside of me that it's starting to drown out those feelings...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I sorta already know the reason behind that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'd been watching my dad and his team sing since I was little, so I always dreamed of having a partner someday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Someone with the same dream as me. Someone who'd chase after that dream with me. That's what I'd always wanted...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I struggled to find the right partner...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, Kohane appeared out of nowhere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The way she sang made my heart race like crazy. Not only that, she said that she wanted to help make my dream come true... I was so happy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So when I think about how I want to cherish her, I start feeling this need to stay together as partners and to make sure I'm her equal...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I know the reason behind what I'm feeling... But I have no idea what I'm supposed to do about it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But how do you actually deal with something like this...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... How can we...? Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You haven't told Kohane about any of this yet, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes!
She doesn't know about this doubt you've been feeling, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't you just tell her everything?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I understand why you believe this is your problem to deal with alone, An, but I actually believe otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Obviously, telling her that seeing her improve so rapidly is unnerving for you may confuse her...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But if I were Kohane, I'd want you to tell me about anything that's bothering you. I'd want to help you if I could.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I should tell her...how I feel...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That never would've crossed my mind...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(The answer might just be that simple.
Tell Kohane so that we can figure this out together—)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still....kinda don't want to tell Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I feel like doing so would confuse her a lot...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(How do I put it?
Just thinking about what's going to happen when I tell her...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane just sent me a message...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Same here.
<The train's running a little late, so I won't make it for a bit.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right...
It's almost time for practice, so we should also get going...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for taking the time to talk with me, you guys.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll spend some more time giving this some thought on my own. Like Luka said, I'm sure there are plenty of other good solutions out there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay.
Please come back if you'd like to talk some more.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Alright, go show them what you've got!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, let's begin our debrief.
We'll start like always by talking about what we could've done better.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, so... I feel like we could've done a slightly better job today of building up anticipation during the pre-chorus...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Tell me about it!
I'm probably gonna collapse on my bed when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know the feeling.
Like when you start nodding off while drying your hair after taking a nice bath.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Then you sleep like a log, and all of a sudden you open your eyes and it's morning.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In that sense, our lifestyle's been really hectic lately.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I can't thank your dad enough, An.
I've been having a lot of fun improving so much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An... I promise to try harder.
So that we can surpass RAD WEEKEND together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh no! The light's about to turn red!
See you later, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Ever since that day, I've been trying to figure out what to do about these feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An... I promise to try harder.
So that we can surpass RAD WEEKEND together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I couldn't genuinely smile back at her...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can't let things go on like this...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But what am I supposed to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't you just tell her everything?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
A message? But it's so late...
Who's it from...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He should be somewhere around... Aha!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sorry, Shiraishi.
I know it's late.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But what are you doing out so late?
We could've talked after practice, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wasn't sure it was the best time to do it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was hoping we could talk when neither Akito nor Azusawa were around.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The truth is, there's something I realized I have to say to you regarding the problem you told us about a few months ago.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Remember what Luka suggested when you talked to us? She said that you may want to try telling Azusawa what you've been feeling...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But you chose not to.
Are you with me so far?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I couldn't get the way you looked that time out of my head.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because it reminded me of someone else.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you're repeating the same mistake.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The one I made when I tried to leave BAD DOGS.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That time, I tried to leave without actually telling Akito how I felt.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was afraid of telling him that I didn't have a big dream like he did. I was afraid of telling him the truth.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was afraid of disappointing him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agreed to chase after his dream as his partner, so I didn't want to let him down... I was afraid of what he'd say.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Don't you feel the same way, Shiraishi...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have the feeling that you're afraid of what Azusawa is going to say if you decide to tell her the truth.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Is that what's been going on with me...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When you put it all together like that, it becomes obvious that I've been super scared.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Which means...
I'm also afraid of letting Kohane down.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Every time she looks my way, her eyes sparkle.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Plus, she always talks about how exciting the way I sing is, that I'm really cool... And how she looks up to me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... I'm none of those things.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm really just scared and weak... More than I realized...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know I just have to keep trying, but every time I hear Kohane sing, it brings back that anxiety...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure that Kohane won't feel disappointed or anything after she sees the real me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have a feeling that she'll say she still looks up to me regardless of who I really am.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which means I'm getting all scared over nothing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't want things to be that way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't want Kohane to see how lame I really am. I don't want her to know.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want her to genuinely believe in me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why... I don't want to tell her anything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
When I said how I didn't want to tell her...
It wasn't really for her sake.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was just...trying to protect myself...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The more someone means to you, the greater the fear of disappointing them becomes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I also hid what I was feeling.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I only felt like I was Akito's real partner after I told him the truth.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, the thought of disappointing someone is scary.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But telling them the truth can lead to new doors opening.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At least, that's what I believe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Give me some time to think.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: About how I'm going to tell Kohane everything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, the thought of disappointing someone is scary.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But telling them the truth can lead to new doors opening.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At least, that's what I believe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Telling her the truth might help me figure out what to do about the way I've been feeling.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Actually, it probably won't be the end of all that. I honestly have no idea what's going to happen afterwards.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But if there's a chance of a positive outcome...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm down to my last card, but I'm too scared to play it...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What would Aunt Nagi do in this situation...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (What would she have done if she saw Dad or Uncle Taiga turning into superstars or something...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “I'll just have to overtake both of you.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And she wouldn't just talk things through. She'd battle it out...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So that I can finally become her real partner.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You want me...to battle against you, An...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of how quickly you've been growing.
Of how much your singing has improved.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm scared that, someday, I won't be able to excite you anymore...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I didn't want you to know that I've been feeling this way, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was afraid that you'd feel disappointed after seeing how lame I really am...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You'd never feel that way about me.
But...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't stop myself from feeling scared.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, I gave this a lot of thought.
About how to deal with this fear.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And then Aunt Nagi popped into my head.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She'd never have hid anything from her teammates.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She'd talk about everything about herself she thought was weak or pathetic, and she'd...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Try to go further.
That's what I realized.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you're afraid of seeing people get better than you, then you just gotta overtake them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You gotta go higher and further.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I know what I need to do now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to keep staying ahead of you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I need you to keep looking up to me. And to prove that I will...I want to battle you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm sorry for asking you to do this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I need you to battle against me. Please.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I felt really happy for a moment.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is probably going to sound really weird, so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm happy to hear that you want to win against me so badly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Well, we're here...
So much for not having practice today.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, but I was starting to get antsy at home. Practicing here help gets rid of all that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I know how you feel.
But given that Shiraishi and Azusawa aren't here, they must be resting as per our original plan.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah. We've been told to give our throats a break today, so let's just practice for a bit and then go—

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hey, perfect!
Let's go watch for a bit!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, we don't have time for... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hey, wait!
Where are you going, Akito?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Where'd he go?!
I could've sworn I just saw him walk past the cafe...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What are you all doing here?

rows.Speaker: EVER Member
rows.Line: Oh... We just happened to be in the neighborhood...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We owe the guy from the record store a favor, and he asked us to help sort out the inventory.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We just finished, and we're about to head out...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: But all these people are blocking the way because of those two... There's no way for me to get my motorcycle out.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Huh? Who are you guys talking about?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Shiraishi and Azusawa.
They're apparently having a battle just down the street.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She chose to battle against her...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In order to overcome her fear of seeing her partner dash ahead?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Huh? What are you guys talking about?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There has to be a reason behind them having a battle.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
In any case, let's go!
What happens with them moving forward might hang on this battle.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If there's even a tiny part of you that still wants to perform with us, then please come see her resolve for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Whoa! Look at this crowd...!
There's gotta be like a hundred people here!

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line:
Oh...!
You're the rest of Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Experienced Staff Member
rows.Line:
H-Hey, what's going on?!
Why are those two battling it out?!

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: I started hearing some amazing singing out on the street. I couldn't believe it was them!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Lady
rows.Line:
This isn't like those two...
Are they having a fight or something...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have a feeling that this is something Shiraishi needs to do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, so we'd appreciate it if you just sat back and watched.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Looks like we won't be able to leave any time soon.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(The way her voice pierces my heart...
She's really just like...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(The way An's singing...
I can tell she's absolutely determined to win...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This is nothing like when we sing together on stage. I've been getting goosebumps just listening to her...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The way she sings really has this way of exciting me. It makes me want to sing like her...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've learned a lot since meeting her and learning how to sing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Singing's a part of my identity now.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I've learned how sour defeat can taste.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I don't want to lose, even to An!!)

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Seriously, how high is her ceiling...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: One could say the same of Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Thanks for throwing everything you have at me.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've been hearing you sing for a long time now, but this is easily your best performance yet.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And you get that you need to give me everything you've got, or this battle won't matter...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm really scared about doing this. Even right now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Because losing means having to live with this doubt.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(We'll keep singing together...
But I'll be in fear while I do.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Which is why... I'm going to win.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (In order to keep standing proud by your side.)

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Why's Shiraishi willing to go this far...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okazaki...
Have you ever felt afraid?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She's been afraid this whole time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She's doing this to overcome that fear.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (When did all these people show up...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness.
They all came to watch.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I was sure they'd all show up if we sang here.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (To be fair, I lost sight of everything else once our battle started.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But this is the perfect stage for it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's settle it with this next one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was just thinking the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: H-How much higher can she go...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, how does she do it...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (You just keep finding ways to get better.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Even during this battle...
It's both scary and unbelievable how you're able to do that.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That's why you make my heart race so much.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (You still don't fully understand why you're the best partner I could ever ask for.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (You have this way of digging up everything that's been laying dormant inside of me. My doubts, how lame I really am...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I never wanted to face those things, but I'm really glad that I did now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I want to do the same to you.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I want to draw everything out of you.
Hidden talents, emotions you didn't know you felt... All of it...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I want my singing to do that!)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
That's the best she's done so far today!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're not gonna know what to do with yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Frizzly-Haired Record Store Clerk
rows.Line: You're doing great, An!!! You can win this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I can keep going...!
I'm not about to stop here...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I grew up here, I trained with Nagi and her team, and everyone showered me with love and affection.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We made the commitment to take up that mantle, and we've been able to come this far!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(So, I know I can surpass her!
No...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Whoa!!
Did you see what she just did...?! That was awesome...!!

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
Way to go, An!
That was awesome!!!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Nice performance, Kohane!
That was an incredible battle!!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: To be perfectly honest, I got so excited that I forgot we were having a battle.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But... I also don't like losing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, An, let's do this again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Next time, I'm going to win.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... I'm gonna win again when we do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I can keep being the best partner you could ever ask for!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Now I see. It all makes sense now...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Sometimes I'll win, sometimes she will.
I'll be in the lead for one minute, and she will the next.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But we'll keep pushing each other forward.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That's what I've always wanted. A real partner.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Man, the battle's over, but everyone's still bouncing off the walls...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
That day when we battled against Taiga...
I became convinced that there was no way for us to win.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: It felt like I was on my motorcycle smashing head-first into a semi.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
But...
I'm not sure I should've given up so easily.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We originally began singing because we really admired this one senior of ours who was chasing after an impossible dream that others laughed at.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: But we decided to stop chasing the impossible... We said, “We'll never succeed, so why bother?”

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: But that was clearly just an excuse.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: The prospect of not winning, of losing that badly again... We haven't been able to shake that fear.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: It started to feel like a fact we couldn't change.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: She overcame the fear within herself.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: So, you guys, how about we quit running already...?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We need to keep fighting until we find a way to win.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
That's our mission.
That's why we're called EVER.

rows.Speaker: EVER Member
rows.Line: We gotta get back on track...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Will you let us back into your group?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Looks like things are starting to settle down.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're going to go beyond Nagi's dream!

rows.Speaker: Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Wait, you don't know?
She was a member of RADder.

rows.Speaker: Local Musicians
rows.Line:
So, that means going beyond RADder...
Like, surpassing RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want to take her hopes and dreams and go where she couldn't.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want to take what she entrusted me with that night and make her proud.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want you all to join us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, you're coming with us whether you like it or not!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nagi's dream! All of your hopes!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're gonna carry them with us!
We're gonna take them to heights you can't imagine!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're gonna show all of you something that you couldn't see even at RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: To see where you all go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this with me today, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was able to overcome all the doubt and fear I've been feeling up until now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What we did today made me want to get even better.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...
Do you think you'll be able to accomplish your task, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It's going to be really hard...
But I think I will be able to now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In that case, I'll be looking forward to seeing some good results, partner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys...!
Thanks for coming to watch us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We should be the ones thanking you.
They decided to come back because of what you just did.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Your battle helped open our eyes.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: We look forward to working with you all again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Likewise!
Thanks so much for deciding to come back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Next time, we're for sure gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND!
